## device.settings — Read device settings

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/settings/read`
- CLI: **supported**. `settings view`; `settings get`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.SettingsView`; `Client.Settings`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `read`.
Requirement mode: `fixed`. Unconditional commands: `1034 GET_DEVICE_SETTINGS`.

Web returns a redacted SettingsView. Sleep/threshold getters are optional probes and unsupported fields remain unknown.

In native maintenance mode this read supports pairing inspection/readback. General settings changes remain on the Python bridge.

Sources: [settings_view.go](../settings_view.go), [settings.go](../settings.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go).

## device.configure — Configure device settings

- WEB: **supported**. `POST /api/settings/configure`; `POST /api/features/check`
- CLI: **supported**. `settings configure`; `settings set`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.ConfigureSettings`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

- animation: `1016 GET_ANIMATION_MODE`, `1015 SET_ANIMATION_MODE`
- sleep: `1039 GET_SLEEP_TIMEOUT`, `1040 SET_SLEEP_TIMEOUT`
- long-press threshold: `1041 GET_LONG_PRESS_THRESHOLD`, `1042 SET_LONG_PRESS_THRESHOLD`
- short/long buttons: `1026 GET_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1027 SET_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1028 GET_LONG_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1029 SET_LONG_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`
- save: `1013 SAVE_SETTINGS`

Selected settings expand exact getter/setter and final-read/save requirements. PIN/pairing changes require direct serial. Web submits background tasks and never retries writes.

Native USB maintenance accepts pairing-only patches. Ordinary and mixed patches require the Python bridge; a bridge still cannot change pairing.

Sources: [settings_workflow.go](../settings_workflow.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go).

## device.pairing — Pairing PIN, policy and bonds

- WEB: **partial**. `POST /api/settings/configure`
- CLI: **supported**. `settings set --name ble-key`; `settings set --name ble-pairing`; `settings clear-bonds`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.SetBLEKey`; `Client.SetBLEPairing`; `Client.ClearBLEBonds`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `pairing`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

- PIN: `1030 SET_BLE_PAIRING_KEY`
- pairing policy: `1037 SET_BLE_PAIRING_ENABLE`
- delete bonds: `1032 DELETE_ALL_BLE_BONDS`

Web supports PIN and pairing policy through settings; bond clearing has no Web entry.

Native CLI operations require --native-usb and an explicit physical application port. SDK callers use OpenNativeUSBContext; USB bridge restrictions remain in force.

Sources: [settings.go](../settings.go), [transport_info.go](../transport_info.go).

## transport.usb-bridge — USB serial TCP bridge

- WEB: **supported**. `POST /api/session/connect`; `GET /api/session/status`; `POST /api/session/disconnect`
- CLI: **supported**. `info`
- SDK: **supported**. `OpenContext`; `Client.TransportInfo`; `NewUSBBridge`

Models: ultra, lite (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `offline`.
Requirement mode: `external`. Unconditional commands: None.

Routine USB application access uses the Python bridge; Open/OpenContext and ordinary CLI/Web sessions no longer open native serial ports.

Fixed mode uses --serial-port. Managed mode uses --usb with --control-port and --token-file; Desk Web uses --usb-bridge and CLI discovery uses usb scan.

Pairing, reset, full-device restore, bootloader entry and DFU remain restricted on USB bridges. Use the explicit native maintenance or DFU path for those operations.

Sources: [tools/ble_bridge/bridge.py](../tools/ble_bridge/bridge.py), [tools/ble_bridge/serial_backend.py](../tools/ble_bridge/serial_backend.py), [transport_info.go](../transport_info.go).

## transport.native-usb-maintenance — Explicit native USB maintenance

- WEB: **partial**. `GET /api/settings/read`; `POST /api/settings/configure`; `GET /api/features/device`
- CLI: **supported**. `devices --native-usb`; `settings get`; `settings set`; `settings reset`; `settings factory-reset`; `firmware enter`; `backup restore`
- SDK: **supported**. `OpenNativeUSBContext`; `Client.BackupForRestore`

Models: ultra, lite (device-independent).
Transport policy: `pairing`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `external`. Unconditional commands: None.

Native application serial access is limited to model/capability and settings inspection, pairing, reset, restore prerequisites, full restore and bootloader entry. General USB application commands require the Python bridge.

CLI requires --native-usb. Web requires serve --native-usb-maintenance PATH; Web exposes pairing readback and edits, not full-device restore or DFU.

Stop the bridge data session before opening native maintenance or DFU. No automatic fallback or command replay is performed.

Sources: [native_usb.go](../native_usb.go), [transport_info.go](../transport_info.go), [backup.go](../backup.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve.go).

## device.session — Web TCP sessions and explicit native maintenance

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/session/status`; `POST /api/session/connect`; `POST /api/session/disconnect`
- CLI: **partial**. `devices --native-usb`; `usb scan`; `serve`
- SDK: **partial**. `Ports`; `OpenContext`

Models: any (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `connection`.
Requirement mode: `external`. Unconditional commands: None.

Ordinary sessions accept TCP targets only. USB selection uses Python bridge management; the former native ports endpoint returns an empty list for compatibility.

serve --native-usb-maintenance fixes an explicit maintenance port. Application endpoints stay disabled; connection changes retain existing session identity and serialization rules.

Sources: [cmd/chameleon/serve_session.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_session.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve.go), [cmd/chameleon/webui/app.js](../cmd/chameleon/webui/app.js).

## device.tasks — Background Web device tasks

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/tasks`; `POST /api/tasks`
- CLI: **missing**.
- SDK: **missing**.

Models: any (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `external`. Unconditional commands: None.

Task controls have their own lifecycle. Underlying operation checks and session identity remain authoritative.

Progress is a phase and protocol attempt/response count, not a percentage. Cancellation is not rollback; interrupted writes can have an unknown outcome.

Task records survive browser reload, not server restart. No automatic reconnect or mutation replay.

Settings reads/configuration and slot details/edits are also supported task operations.

Sources: [cmd/chameleon/serve_tasks.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_tasks.go), [cmd/chameleon/webui/background-tasks.js](../cmd/chameleon/webui/background-tasks.js), [docs/background-tasks.md](../docs/background-tasks.md).

## slot.read-details — Read slot configuration and nicknames

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/slot/details`
- CLI: **supported**. `slot list`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.SlotDetails`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `read`.
Requirement mode: `fixed`. Unconditional commands: `1008 GET_SLOT_TAG_NICK`, `1018 GET_ACTIVE_SLOT`, `1019 GET_SLOT_INFO`, `1023 GET_ENABLED_SLOTS`.

Read-only discovery is separate from parameter-dependent nickname mutations. Missing nicknames are not errors.

Sources: [slot_workflows.go](../slot_workflows.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go).
